build_scope: Reuse the pinned OpenWrt tree and toolchain/package caches; clean only the kernel build to remove prior RAM experiments, regenerate PE, then make world. No full test suite.

flash.note: Old SSH connection timed out after Wi-Fi shutdown; TTL captures the write and Flash boot, and a new SSH connection verifies the installed release. UART adapter later reported host I/O errors; no postboot TTL result is claimed.

test_scope: Mac en0 5GHz HE160, channel44/center50, using project NI/FE simulation endpoints. No physical PON egress or PPPoE negotiation. One short run per default TCP/UDP direction, followed by focused controls for failures.
fixture_address: 198.18.255.1 replaces 198.18.0.1 only in copied simulation/receiver sources to avoid the Mac tunnel local address. Artifact test-address.patch preserves the three module constant changes; production driver source is unchanged.

UDP_download_100_wire_Mbps.purpose: Check low-rate frame formatting and delivery after the high-rate failure.

prior_RAM_CPU_profile.TCP_download_limitation: PE route restarted during measurement; counters decreased. Excluded from hardware throughput acceptance. This changes multiple CPU settings and does not isolate a unique root cause.

unresolved: High-rate downlink hardware tail drops remain; L2QM EQ register reads 0x81d40000 as committed, so reservation enable alone has not fixed this result.
Default TCP upload saturates CPU0 near95%; moving the IRQ/RPS profile improves throughput but is not a firmware root-cause fix.
Mac transmit queue drops account for the missing default UDP-upload packets.
A PE route restart invalidates the hardware counter comparison in the downlink CPU control.
